title: VOA Newsroom: 500 Words ESL Studio
description: A production-ready, browser-native ESL vocabulary studio with 500 curated newsroom words, six learning desks, SRS timestamp math, live VOA Learning English headlines, native speech APIs, and portable progress files.

build.note: Elapsed time from the OpenCode session creation to the token snapshot used for this state file. The final commit/push and closing response occur outside the snapshot.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record when the project was packaged. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are reported separately because they are a subset of context usage.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.

verification: 500 words validated: 500 unique entries, 125 per category, no missing IPA/syllable/definition fields.
SRS interval math verified: 1, 3, 3, 7, 7, 30, 30 days; sixth review sets Mastered and +30 days.
Chrome headless smoke test: 36 cards rendered, all six activity panels open, no console errors.
Live RSS verified against VOA Learning English: live badge, highlighted headline, and original VOA link rendered.
Export verified: voa_learning_progress.txt downloaded with 500 word records and imported successfully.
Responsive checks at 1600px, 1440px, 1024px, and 390px; mobile HUD stacks and the word studio opens as a near-full-screen modal.
GitHub Pages build completed successfully; index.html, style.css, script.js, and screenshot.png served with HTTP 200.
Word studio converted to a large accessible modal (1280px desktop / near-full-screen mobile) with backdrop close, Escape close, focus trap, and focus return.
Sentence bank verified: four examples per word, refresh cycling, sentence audio, fill-in-the-blank checking, and SRS update.
Font size control verified from 80% to 140%, persisted through reload and progress export/import.
Read-aloud refresh verified against live VOA, Free Dictionary API, Wiktionary, and Wikipedia, with offline fallback to built-in examples.
credits: Built with OpenCode 2.2.5 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash). Live headlines from VOA Learning English via rss2json. This is an independent learning project, not an official VOA product.
